question: How does abstaining from food by day lead to overcoming death by aging?
premises: The practice involves non-eating by day.
The threat addressed is death by aging.
The practitioner will go beyond that death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean go to or go beyond death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
